title: Siren Wail
blurb: A two-and-a-half-second frequency sweep that reads instantly as emergency without belonging to any particular service. That vagueness is useful. It keeps the file safe to use anywhere, since it impersonates no real siren. Semantically it lands as something is happening and it is probably your fault. Use it for dramatic edits, for prank alarms, or as the soundtrack to somebody announcing a terrible decision in the group chat. Original synthesis, clean, free MP3, no blue lights implied and none legally required.
origin: Original frequency-swept synthesis in the style of a generic emergency siren.
